conversation_history.content: Which specific event should define the cohort index date for “patients with type 2 diabetes”? Options: first-ever diagnosis of type 2 diabetes; first diagnosis during the observation window; any diagnosis occurrence (including recurrent); first prescription or dispensing of an antidiabetic medication (e.g., metformin); hospitalization for hyperglycemia; or another event? If you choose “first”, do you mean first-ever in the patient record or first during a specified prior observation period?

Do you want any age or sex restrictions for this cohort? If yes, specify an age range (for example: adults aged 18 years and older, or 40–75 years) and which sexes to include (male, female, or both). If you prefer default, reply 'standard'.
adults aged 18 years and older, both sexes

Do you require a minimum continuous observation (medical/insurance record) period before the index date? For example, 365 days of prior observation. If yes, please specify the duration in days (or reply 'no requirement').

Do you want to exclude patients with any of the following before the index date: prior diagnosis of type 1 diabetes, gestational diabetes (during pregnancy), secondary diabetes (e.g., due to pancreatic disease or medication), or prior use of antidiabetic medications? If yes, please specify which of these to exclude (you may choose one or more). If none, reply 'no exclusions'.

How should cohort exit (post-index follow-up) be defined? Choose one option and provide details if needed: (A) end of patient's continuous observation (end of available medical/insurance records); (B) death; (C) a fixed duration after the index date (specify length, e.g., 1 year); (D) occurrence of a clinical event that ends follow-up (specify event, e.g., initiation of insulin, hospitalization for hyperglycemia); or (E) no exit until end of database. If you want a combination (for example, fixed duration OR death), say so.
✅ **Clarification complete!** I have all the information needed to define your cohort.

cohort_definition.index_event: First-ever diagnosis of type 2 diabetes (the first recorded diagnosis of type 2 diabetes in the patient's medical record)
inclusion_criteria: Diagnosis must be the patient’s first-ever recorded diagnosis of type 2 diabetes.
exclusion_criteria: Any diagnosis of type 1 diabetes recorded before the index date.
cohort_definition.observation_window: Post-index follow-up from the index date until the end of the patient’s continuous observation (end of available medical/insurance records).

demographics.age: Adults aged 18 years and older at index date

cohort_definition.prior_observation: No prior continuous observation required before index.
cohort_definition.cohort_exit: Exit at end of continuous observation (end of available records).
